## Description

Clusters multi-scale topological persistence diagrams from rolling correlation point clouds using Wasserstein distances, triggering systemic risk alerts when topological cluster structures mutate abruptly.

## Where it may fit

Pre-crash market environments, systemic credit crunches, sudden correlation breakdowns.

## Vehicles

Tail-Risk Hedge Funds, Institutional Risk Management Desks, Global Macro Funds.

## Required data

Rolling cross-asset correlation matrices, multivariate asset return series.

## Caveats

Persistence diagram clustering requires robust distance metric selection (e.g., bottleneck distance).
